setup.name: The setup
setup.text: An apprentice discovers that sounds within the chest can be heard more clearly through a hollow tube.

choices.label: Test the tube on willing villagers.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The healer learns to distinguish several sounds but cannot yet explain them.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A healthy villager's unusual breathing is mistaken for illness until another healer listens.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The patient is treated cautiously, though a subtle change goes unnoticed.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The healer recognizes the patient's distress without needing the new device.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The healers identify a worsening illness and begin supportive care.

c2__fx.name: Outcome C2
c2__fx.text: The tube's sound conflicts with other signs, and the healers record their uncertainty.
